info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Human Resource Management Workforce Trainings-spec
info.description: The Workforce Training Management API provides access to a comprehensive list of training programs available within the Human Resource Management framework. This endpoint allows users to retrieve detailed information about various workforce training opportunities, including course descriptions, schedules, and eligibility requirements. Ideal for HR professionals and training coordinators, this API supports use cases such as tracking employee development and enhancing workforce skills. By leveraging this API, organizations can efficiently manage and optimize their training resources.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch detailed information regarding workforce training programs available within the Human Resource Management system. It is designed for accessing training data that supports employee development and skill enhancement initiatives.

requestBody.description: This request allows you to retrieve information related to workforce training within the human resource management system. The body must conform to the specified schema to ensure all necessary data is included.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the training data.

ListHumanResourceManagementWorkforceTrai.description: A JSON string representing the request body for the GET operation related to workforce training in human resource management.

items.description: A list of employee records related to workforce training.

sort.description: The sorting order of the results.
